measurement.name: South Pacific Current
measurement.range_interpretation: Reported enhanced eastward band less than200 km in one historical section. Representative width, lower bound, confidence limits, whole-current envelope and annual range remain unknown.
measurement.geographic_scope: Western South Pacific near Chatham Rise; Baldrige section d at nominal170 W in March1990. Front station table gives170.6 W; exact width edges unresolved.
measurement.section_orientation: Nominal meridional hydrographic section; no diagnosed flow-normal axis or paired width endpoints.
measurement.layer: Enhanced eastward relative-geostrophic band in Figure3 upper1000 m context. Surface-intensified flow; exact width-evaluation depth unknown. No uniform vertical width slab.
measurement.time_convention: March1990, late austral summer, from Table1(d) and Figure3 caption. Exact occupation days and annual coverage unavailable.
measurement.boundary_rule: Author reports band less than200 km wide. No numeric edge cutoff or geographic edge pair supplied; peak/sampled velocities are context only.
measurement.source_citation: Stramma, L., R.G. Peterson and M. Tomczak (1995), The South Pacific Current, Journal of Physical Oceanography25,77-91.
measurement.source_locator: Original p82 right column; Table1(d) p79, Table2(d) p83 and Figure3/caption p84. Rejected illustrative100 km assumption: p89.
measurement.extraction_method: Source qualifier and context transcribed after visual review of original pages. No source curve or edge digitization.
measurement.source_quality_note: Original15-page scan retained unchanged and ignored. Full field curves, edge coordinates and width uncertainty have not been digitized or inferred. Frontal bracket differs from velocity width.

March 1990 dates the observation; 1995 is publication. The 100 km transport assumption and greater-than-500 km separation from ACC flow are distinct contextual values.

No 200 km point, zero-to-200 interval, geographic width band or annual range.
